name: zeffect_update_beam_node_between_points
description: zEffect::UpdateBeamNodeBetweenPoints positions, orients, scales, and returns the length of an Object3D beam between two points.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native beam update tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x458c10 validates null-object zero return, source-position set, Vec3DirectionAnglesBetweenPoints rotation path with roll zero, existing x/y scale preservation, length approximation from squared distance, z-scale update, and returned length.
The native parent/attach/detach smoke verifies position, zero-rotation case, preserved x/y scale, z-scale length, and returned length for a two-unit beam.
